v-maison-jeunet.name: Maison Jeunet par Steven Naessens
v-maison-jeunet.address: Château de Germigney, 31 rue Edgar Faure, 39600 Port-Lesney
v-maison-jeunet.verdict: The Arbois two-star of Jean-Paul Jeunet, carried by his successor Steven Naessens to the Château de Germigney at Port-Lesney in November 2021: Morbier and Morteau cromesquis, snails in Savagnin broth, Bresse poultry with Vin Jaune and morels.
v-maison-jeunet.signature: Bresse poultry with Vin Jaune and morels.
v-maison-jeunet._lane: The stars on the slope — two Michelin houses and the Bib by the river

v01-la-table-du-grapiot.name: La Table du Grapiot
tags: Michelin one star — new in March 2026 (Gault & Millau Jeune Talent on reopening)
v01-la-table-du-grapiot.why: Michelin one star — new in March 2026 (Gault & Millau Jeune Talent on reopening). To order: the tasting menu — Vivien Sonzogni's cuisine of memory: pike & blette with miso; trout & Morteau sausage; artichoke & beef tongue. Chef Vivien Sonzogni (35), associates Noémie Paris / Violette / Hugo. Took over June 2024; first ★ March 2026. The village of Pierre Overnoy is across the road — a natural-wine pilgrimage with a star at the end of it. Bistrot side opens June–August (Thu–Mon).
v01-la-table-du-grapiot._lane: The stars on the slope — two Michelin houses and the Bib by the river

v02-le-bistron-me.name: Le Bistronôme
tags: Michelin Bib Gourmand (held); Gault & Millau selected; Pudlowski: "une leçon de haute bistronomie"
EUR 27 lunch / 37 dinner / 55 à la carte
v02-le-bistron-me.why: Michelin Bib Gourmand (held); Gault & Millau selected; Pudlowski: "une leçon de haute bistronomie". To order: ballottine of Planches trout stuffed with morels & oyster mushrooms in Vin Jaune sauce; veal picanha marinated in soy + Vin Jaune; roast veal sweetbreads with smoked-cheese sauce + salted churros. Chefs Jérôme Brousseau (kitchen) + Léa Vuillemin (pastry), both former apprentices of Jeunet and Naessens. Closed Sun-Mon; closed Thu eves Nov-Mar. Wine list exclusively Jura.
v02-le-bistron-me._lane: The stars on the slope — two Michelin houses and the Bib by the river

v03-tablier.name: Ô Tablier
tags: Gault & Millau selected; #1-rated restaurant in Lons (TripAdvisor 4.9/5, 300+ reviews)
v03-tablier.why: Gault & Millau selected; #1-rated restaurant in Lons (TripAdvisor 4.9/5, 300+ reviews). To order: four starters / four mains / two desserts — rewritten regularly; the Comté and Morteau will be where they belong on the menu. Chefs Louise Crétin (kitchen) + Thomas Berthod (salle). Short-circuit, seasonal, local, organic where possible. The best expression of Jura terroir in central Lons. Unusual split hours — verify before going.
v03-tablier._lane: Lons at table — the town's own kitchens

v05-la-petite-auberge.name: La Petite Auberge
tags: Gault & Millau listed — chef's table on the northern approach
v05-la-petite-auberge.why: Gault & Millau listed — chef's table on the northern approach. To order: morel & Vin Jaune crust; Jura trout with roasted bacon; Dombes duck; soufflé glacé au Macvin (Véronique's dessert). Chefs Véronique & Nicolas Narbey (ex-Château d'As Baume-les-Dames, ex-Matignon). Mon lunch; Tue-Fri lunch + dinner; Sun lunch. Closed Sat and Mon eve.
v05-la-petite-auberge._lane: Lons at table — the town's own kitchens

v06-le-bistrot-des-marronniers.name: Le Bistrot des Marronniers
tags: Lyonnais-Jura hybrid bouchon since 1987 — wood-fired grill in the room
v06-le-bistrot-des-marronniers.why: Lyonnais-Jura hybrid bouchon since 1987 — wood-fired grill in the room. To order: tablier de sapeur (Lyonnais tripe), pike-perch fillet with Poulsard wine, calf liver with Macvin. Half Lyonnais bouchon, half Jura. David & Jean-Michel, co-proprietors. The grill is the centerpiece of the dining room.
v06-le-bistrot-des-marronniers._lane: Lons at table — the town's own kitchens

v04-la-com-die.name: La Comédie
tags: The Place de la Comédie's resident table — renovated historic monument, coloured arcades
v04-la-com-die.why: The Place de la Comédie's resident table — renovated historic monument, coloured arcades. To order: the Plaisir 5-course or Découverte 6-course; menus du Marché change weekly. Chefs Lucie & Guillaume Ferrier. Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 19:00–22:00. Comté, Mont d'Or, Morteau and Jura wines throughout the menu.
v04-la-com-die._lane: ALTERNATE for the Lons lane (cut for the cap unless a kept table fails)

v07-la-table-de-perraud.name: La Table de Perraud
tags: Gault & Millau listed — reliable traditional table
v07-la-table-de-perraud.why: Gault & Millau listed — reliable traditional table. To order: pochouse jurassienne (the Jura's freshwater fish stew in white wine and cream), choucroute, andouillette with mustard cream, lamb shoulder. Chef Gabriel Janod. Named for the Jurassien sculptor Jean-Joseph Perraud. The pochouse is the Lyonnais-equivalent dish to test.
v07-la-table-de-perraud._lane: ALTERNATE for the Lons lane (cut for the cap unless a kept table fails)
